extraction_scope: Worker-6 adjudicated mechanism ontology from primary source locators without promoting context-only notes to unsupported direct mechanisms.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: NK-2 derivatives preferentially intercalated into negatively charged PS-containing or pure PS liposome membranes, supporting a membrane-interaction mechanism tied to surface-exposed PS rather than nonspecific PC membrane insertion.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: C7A, C7A-D21K, C7A-Δ, NK11, and Melittin as tested peptides; C7A-D21K kinetics shown representatively

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=6:Membrane intercalation of peptides monitored by FRET spectroscopy
source_locator.evidence: FRET assay measured donor/acceptor ratio changes after peptide addition to PC, PC:PS, and PS liposomes.

mechanism_claims.limitations: Liposome FRET is a model-membrane assay; it supports membrane intercalation but does not alone prove the full tumor-cell killing mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: HDP-treated HROC24 and HROC18 cells showed predominantly necrotic death with some apoptosis, while Bax/HSP90/PARP results did not support a dominant canonical apoptosis pathway for NK-2 derivatives.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: C7A, C7A-D21K, C7A-Δ, NK11, and Melittin in HROC24/HROC18 cells
direct_assay_types: western blot for Bax, HSP90, and cleaved PARP

source_locator.evidence: Results text states necrosis was predominant and cleaved PARP was not detectable.

mechanism_claims.limitations: Cell-death mode was tested in selected high-PS HROC24/HROC18 lines and should not be generalized to all CRC models without caution.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Tumor-cell susceptibility partly tracked surface-exposed PS, but the authors explicitly conclude that vulnerability was also cell-line and peptide specific.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: CRC cell panel including HCT116, HROC18, HROC24, HROC40, HROC60, HROC113, HROC32, and HROC107

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=8:Response to HDPs according to PS-expression status
source_locator.evidence: Results text compares PS status with peptide susceptibility and frames PS involvement as partial.

mechanism_claims.limitations: This is an association across PS-status classes and cytotoxicity figures; it is not a single deterministic predictor for all cell lines.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Local C7A/C7A-D21K treatment delayed HROC24 xenograft growth and increased apoptotic staining, but NK11 also delayed growth, so the in vivo effect cannot be attributed solely to NK-2-specific direct cytotoxicity.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: NMRI Foxn1nu mice bearing HROC24 xenografts

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=11:In vivo growth kinetics and tumor cell apoptosis
source_locator.evidence: Results text reports tumor-growth delay and notes the unexpected NK11 effect.

mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper itself treats the NK11 in vivo effect as unexpected and discusses possible microenvironment/innate immune contributions; do not overclaim direct peptide-specific killing in vivo.
